stage: N1.4g core public-consumer candidate exposure index before new parent/path metadata

scan.included_rule: Existing .md/.tsv; or .json whose basename contains protocol, selection, or metadata. New core_consumer_qualification_20261017 subtree excluded. Hash extraction only.
scan.match_rule: Exact 40-hex hash or unique 7–12-hex prefix delimited by non-hex characters, case-insensitive. Only matches to fixed 500 are retained; no matched prose or labels are stored.
scan.scan_boundary: No candidate commit message/diff/source, analysis_out assessment/results, raw model answer, model_review.md, or new parent/path metadata inspected by this index.

method_limits: A path/hash reference is contact evidence, not source reading or semantic truth by itself. Only explicit prior 12 source review and current A/B parent+repair review receive a source-read/development status.
The legacy 13-card intersection is a family/reference warning, not a fresh independent source verdict. Holdout paths distinguish previous review from mere plans, and never prove source isolation.
No scanned hit is not proof of global non-exposure or family independence; unscanned JSON, source assets, external chats, and other records remain outside this bounded audit.
A/B have been read and used for method qualification; 5ebf is already read; 9e9 is deferred as a possible related-theme case without proof of same or different fix family.

During preparatory inventory, the first lines of pilot_500_20260926.tsv inadvertently displayed its model_label column. No label was used in candidate classification, and the file was excluded from this final scan.
No positive, negative, same-mechanism, or same-use-normal truth is assigned here; no candidate is selected by this index.

exposure_sets_scope.known_source_read_or_method_development_: Twelve hashes explicitly in case_reviews.md plus A/B read in the parent qualification method stage; exclude these from an independent same-mechanism test.
exposure_sets_scope.documented_prior_13_case_family_exclude: One fixed-500 hash is an ACPI branch listed in legacy_13_dimensions.tsv C13; excludes as prior case-family contact, not as a proven identical fix commit.
exposure_sets_scope.confirmed_same_fix_family_only_exclude: Empty under this bounded evidence; similarity of author/title/path does not establish one fix family.
exposure_sets_scope.possible_related_theme_defer_no_family_p: 9e9 remains deferred against a8c because similar author/theme; no same/different family claim.
exposure_sets_scope.protocol_selection_metadata_only_no_auto: Metadata path reference alone is not source review and should not automatically remove a candidate.
exposure_sets_scope.research_note_reference_depth_unknown_re: Some non-protocol notes contain the hash, but the scan retained no prose and cannot certify what was read.
exposure_sets_scope.no_match_in_scanned_records_global_statu: No match in 430 named records cannot prove no prior exposure elsewhere.
exposure_sets_scope.holdout_sets: Crosscutting prior holdout review versus only plan/metadata mentions; neither is by itself a fresh independent test.
